title: Somatosensory Cortex Rat DISC Data
description: This dataset contains electrophysiological recordings from rat somatosensory cortex obtained using DISC (Diamond-based Implantable Sensing probes/electrodes) for validation purposes. Anesthetized rats received whisker stimulation via an air puffer, with task labels corresponding to the specific whisker stimulated. The dataset supports validation of DISC neural recording technology in a rodent somatosensory model.
methods_description: Rats were implanted with DISC devices in somatosensory cortex. While anesthetized, individual whiskers were stimulated using an air puffer, with task names corresponding to the identity of the stimulated whisker.
